notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.1.1 - The Last Expedition
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Samurai[/h1]

Welcome to 1.1.1 update brings additional QOL and bugfixes, but this will be the last patch for the entire game.

It’s been a privilege to work on Shadowveil, its been an absolute blast to take part of the Legend of the Five Rings universe, and the team eternally grateful to you, our community for supporting us in creating and launching Shadowveil.
 
Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five RIngs, and hopefully we see each other soon in another context. 
Take care and goodbye.

With love,
The team at Palindrome Interactive

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version number 1.1.1.19063[/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a unique 3D model and portrait for Yasuki Nobitsugu
[*] Added a small VFX outline to map crab to differentiate it better
[*] Added QOL: Barricades now have HP and can be destroyed (5 hits), if enemies can’t reach your units they will target barricades
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127025/147b91e7c0ac966b3e13228a27da21f8785d222c.png[/img]
[h3]Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scouting parties button should now have a tooltip even when not unlocked
[*] ”Shifting Currents” healing breakdown should now correctly show a percentage instead of just a number
[*] Updated LLG sounds
[*] Updated percentage of nezumi favor gifting to show the correct percentages at all times.
[*] Updated enemy loadouts so enemies can now spawn in mixed compositions 
[*] Updated the speaking order of the Lost Library Guardians to better fit the cinematic the first time you encounter them
[*] Replaced reward in Ancient Practice side quest, as the experience gain was never supposed to be there.
[*] Additional Duty Slot upgrade icon is now the same size as all the other upgrades
[*] Ability “Battering Ram” changed to match text
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nezumi favors now get more expensive the more of them you get, and you can only get one per shop visit
[*] Chapter 9 shouldn't give extra Embark Slots
[/list]
[h3]Critical Fixes (Crashes/Softlock)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where loading a save with different items would lead to a crash
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed character bar at the bottom of the screen no longer overlaps quest UI
[*] Fixed run summary not showing correct stats
[*] Fixed issue in Ch10/endless where duty giving you extra temporary command points where permanent
[*] Fixed issue with Deploy All button thinking it actually deployed people when you clicked it during a paused battle
[*] Fixed “Had That, Built Those” challenge/achievement to take the new items into account
[*] Fixed traps no longer disappear after the first trigger if they are allowed to trigger multiple times
[*] Fixed Shadowveil nodes do not change when you retry combat anymore
[*] Fixed issue where paused function may fail to function when starting a battle with space key
[*] Fixed lighting saturation issue encountered act 2 and 3
[*] Fixed issue with mission “Stare into the abyss” that enabled you to complete it incorrectly
[*] Fixed Speed button highlight issues
[*] Fixed “Defeating the elite 2” challenge/achievement
[*] Fixed to be the stone petal effect spread implemented properly now
[*] Fixed run summary information not showing correctly
[*] Fixed left and right scroll in barracks 
[*] Fixed issues regarding recruiting ronin units that was missing names and masteries
[*] Fixed it is no longer possible to pause and unpause combat while the system menu is open
[*] Fixed a short freeze encountered when gifting 8 or more ability cards to the Nezumi at a merchant node
[*] Fixed crop issue in barracks with alternate berserker portrait
[*] Fixed Eternal items can no longer be activated if the equipped unit is not deployed
[*] Fixed so icon is hidden when hovering family tree name
[*] Fixed center screen icon in combat to flash the correct sign when pressing any of the speed control buttons
[*] Fixed ink trail doesn’t linger if axe throw drops target after windup
[*] Fixed sliding issue in tutorial
[*] Fixed path of sunlight widget looked like it was hovered by default
[*] Fixed issue where victory screen flickers upon pressing the Continue button in quick succession
[*] Fixed so Ith'ki should no longer mention taking your coin in Chapter 9, when everything was free of charge
[*] Removed extra space in combat log from enemy buffs and debuffs
[*] Various animation fixes
[*] Localization fixes
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
These are issues that we have seen but not been able to replicate nor have had the time to fix. As a result if you encounter them, reload the save, or load a backup.
[list]
[*] Rare crashes related to rendering, when placing units on boost tiles
[*] Rare crashes related to rendering, when encountering a boss
[*] Loading in run save games with "Hida Logistics" may give extra ability slots incorrectly, however starting a run should reset
[/list]

[h3]Discord[/h3]
Although development has ceased you can discuss the game in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url].

notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.1 - Closing a chapter
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Samurai[/h1]
My name is Filip and I’m the Game Director of Shadowveil.

Welcome to 1.1 our first major update which should make the game it's best, listen to the video where I also talk about some important news, so please watch the entire video.

[previewyoutube=7oMtnnuVcwo;full][/previewyoutube]
This patch should help the game feel more complete, give more build/experimentation opportunities and hopefully just feel better!

However with patch 1.1 also comes the closing of a chapter.
Patch 1.1 will be the last content patch for the game. We have one additional patch planned, 1.1.1 that brings additional QOL and bugfixes, but that will be the last patch for the entire game.

It’s been a privilege to work on Shadowveil, its been an absolute blast to take part of the Legend of the Five Rings universe, and the team and I are eternally grateful to you, our community for supporting us in creating and launching Shadowveil.
 
Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five RIngs, and hopefully we see each other soon in another context. 
Take care and goodbye.

With love,
Filip and the team at Palindrome Interactive

[h1]Patch Notes - 1.1[/h1]
[h2]Version number 1.1.0.18999[/h2]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 18 new ability cards (3 per class)
[*] Added 1 item component
[*] Added 9 item combinations
[*] Added Heroes of the Wall screen in magistrate to commemorate our speedrun winners (congratulations!).
[*] Added new 3D meshes to Lost Library Guardians
[*] Added 6 new alternate portraits to match the randomized meshes to increase differentiation.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127025/125b8746e71870986e5d7c67207328245194a6b8.png[/img]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] QOL: Added ability to skip event text
[*] QOL: Updated so UI should be visible on 16:10 aspect ratio screens (for example Steamdeck)
[*] “Spirit repulse” knockback is now 1 tile as stated
[*] Updated card breakdown on ability “Bloodthirst” and “Invigorating Heat”
[*] Card order in codex has been updated
[*] Changed so that objective marker shows on next step when advancing in missions
[*] Updated so the combat is considered as completed when Madoshi Necromancer dies, even if a summoned Spirit is still present
[*] Readded missing evasion section in codex
[*] You can now hover units in the character bar even when they are not deployed. The unit hover is also hidden when you have the inventory open.
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]
[h3]Embark Slots:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sibling level-up no longer rewards Embark slots.
[/list] This means Maximum Embark slots has been reduced to 7, down from 10.
[list]
[*] Hida Formation
Defense gained increased to 30 up from 10.
Unlocks in chapter 5, up from 1.
[*] Hida Logistics
Unlocks in chapter 1, down from 2.
[*] Reinforcements
Cost decreased to 2, down from 3.
Unlocks in chapter 2, down from 3.
[*] More Reinforcements
Unlocks in chapter 3, down from 4.
[*] Extra Reinforcements
Unlocks in chapter 4, down from 5.
[*] Critical Reinforcements
Cost increased to 4, up from 3.
[/list]
For save files with points invested in any of these Advancement you might see a shift in which Advancements are unlocked now. Worst case scenario you'll have to invest two Political Capital to re-learn one of them. This was the only way to restructure the tree without making a huge investment in rebuilding the save system, or invalidating save files. Sorry about the inconvenience.

notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.0.4 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h1]

We just launched version 1.0.4, and it includes a lot of updates and optimizations. See the full list below!

Shoutout to the player community in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Forum[/url] for providing bug reports, so we can continue to track down and eliminate issues. You're true friends of the Crab Clan!

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] There is a softlock that can happen when entering the Shadowveil and exiting the game to main menu. When in the Shadowveil try to complete the entire path (so you are back on the main map) before exiting the game. This can also happen when using camp in the Shadowveil. For now try to use camp in the main map only. We are looking into hotfixing this next week!
[*] There is rare random crashes during battles which are hard to nail down, as above please report it on discord to help us solve them!
[*] Resolutions with 16:10 or other less common aspect ratios may have issues with the UI
[/list]


[h1]Version number 1.0.4.18507[/h1]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a missing event in earlier versions
[/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
The fifth patch brings the fifth optimization package. This time, further work has gone into VFX (details below) and a large rework of how UI is loaded to save RAM and VRAM.
[list]
[*] All VFX in the game has been tweaked to be more performant
[*] Fire effects are now more fiery!
[*] Optimized UI RAM usage.
[/list]

We've changed the rendering mode for many particles from "Translucent" to "Masked" due to how particle-heavy many fights can be later in the game.
Translucent particles cause heavy overdraw (re-rendering areas where they are) due to how rendering works in modern game engines - "Masked" materials, on the other hand, don't have this issue. 
To retain most of the transparency, we use something called "Dithering" (basically fading into dots), which does cause some graininess but is a good trade-off performance-wise.


[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] QoL: Updated descriptions and breakdowns for Berserker's Rage, Besiege, Burning Blossom Trap, Push Trap, Slash, and Earth Becomes Sky
[*] Event Ancient Temple now gives [spoiler]Kakeguchi's Bane at the end of the run[/spoiler]
[*] Changed what text is Header and Support Header in Fortitude Rewards
[*] Changed camera for card rewards depending on act
[*] Changed the skylight and the map FX to reduce rendering issues
[*] Changed so events stores all event options so that the “not selected” exclamation mark is correctly shown
[*] Changed hovering enemies and inspecting shows only relevant stats
[*] Changed so Corrupted Spirits show Evasion instead of Defense on hover
[*] Changed so markers/deployables can no longer be placed on top of each other
[/list]


[h2]Critical Fixes (Crashes/Softlock)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when that happened on the rare occasion of equipping two eternal items simultaneously. [spoiler]The one selected from embark and Kakeguchi's Bane[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed softlocking issue that disabled players control over moving units
[*] Fixed potential softlock in the tutorial
[*] Fixed a potential softlock in Chapter 6
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Enemy corpses now also become un-interactable when dead
[*] Fixed deck reward packs not showing correctly when there were more than 2 
[*] Fixed so Missions or special nodes now generate the same level content when you retry them
[*] Fixed so Revealing the entire map no longer shows encounters and paths from other acts 
[*] Fixed so that no combine arrow is shown if the item is on a dead unit (as it's locked)
[*] Fixed event hint tooltip showing the "You Receive" header when there are no direct rewards in “A Lost Crab Warrior” event
[*] Fixed issues where certain effects could damage untargetable units causing, issues.
[*] Fixed issue in chapter 5 where multiple bosses appeared present
[*] Fixed ability Shifting Currents cooldown
[*] Fixed issue where victory screen did not show correctly after events
[*] Fixed issues with Challenge “Training Dummy” and “Pessimist” 
[*] Fixed “The Last Disciple” mission to load the correct combat encounter
[*] Fixed previous Saves should now show the correct chapter and act
[*] Fixed node removal vfx played on already removed nodes
[*] Fixed the issue where Shadowveil map disappears after completing a node in the Shadowveil
[*] Fixed issue with Blessings tab overlapping duty selection while making camp, even though it was invisible
[*] Fixed mission “Waters of fury” not counting kills and resetting when returning to watchtower
[*] Fixed “Return to Watchtower” tutorial instruction should now disappear if you make camp while it's active
[*] Fixed issue with unit stat reward header not having the correct text formatting

[/list]

notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.0.3 - Patch Notes - QoL Reinforcements
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h1]

1.0.3 just released, and another patch means another set of patch notes for Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings, so let's dive in. This patch includes some of the first of QoL changes that are highly requested by the community, more to come!
Special thanks to the players in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url] and the players on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Forum[/url] for continuing to report and help track down issues. The Crab Clan appreciates your efforts!

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] We are still verifying why some missions fail to reward the player properly or cannot be redeemed, if this happens to you, please send your save file on discord
[*] There is still rare random crashes in battles or loading save files, as above please report it on discord
[*] Resolutions with 16:10 or other less common aspect ratios may have issues with the UI
[*] Achievements for some don't trigger correctly, we have a potential solution in a upcoming patch
[/list]

[h1]Version number 1.0.3.18376[/h1]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added QoL: Speed from each combat is now kept
[*] Added QoL: Save backups can now be accessed in main menu, and now also keeps the last 3 combats as well as the last 3 watchtower saves
[*] Added QoL: Inventory is accessible during reward screens
[*] Added 2 events that were missing in previous patches
[*] Added small cutscene at each [spoiler]Gragokku[/spoiler] fight to explain his escape

notes.title: Launch Day Update (1.0.0 Patch Notes)
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h1]

Launch Day is upon us, and we'd like to share the list of changes and fixes we've implemented for the full version of Shadowveil. A shoutout to the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Discord community[/url] and the players on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Forum[/url] who has helped nail down some of the issues during the duration of the demo. The Crab Clan commends you!

[h2]PSA Regarding the Demo[/h2]
The save system has changed between the demo and the full version, which means that demo saves will [b]no longer be playable in the full game[/b]. 

You can still enjoy the standalone demo for a bit longer, as it has been received very positively. However as our focus will transition to the full game, the demo will [b]NOT[/b] be updated for a while. There are known issues, performance issues and crashes with the demo that is fixed in the full game (again shoutout to the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Discord community[/url] and the players on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Forum[/url]), which we want to implement in the demo eventually!

[h1]Shadowveil - Launch Day - 1.0.0 Patch Notes 
(04.03.2025)[/h1]
[h3]Exact version number: 1.0.0.17846[/h3]
Spoiler warning: Potential spoilers are listed with spoiler tags: [spoiler]like this[/spoiler]. 

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the full game, defeat the evil forces of the Shadowlands and make the Crab Clan proud!
[*] Added full localization (text only) for French, Italian, German, Spanish(Spain), Portuguese(Brazil) and Simplified Chinese 
[*] Added new music to camp
[/list]

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
This is the first optimization package for the game, while there is work still to be done, this will lower usage of RAM and VRAM significantly, improving performance but most importantly eliminating a majority of crashes reported during the demo.
[list]
[*] Enabled LODs for most objects in-game
[*] Optimized the most commonly used shaders to be more performant
[*] Optimized texture sizes for nonvirtual textures
[*] Optimized textures and shaders for streaming
[*] Improved performance with low and medium global illumination settings. This should lessen the abnormal GPU usage for some GPUs

[h3]Updates[/h3]

[*] Updated difficulty scaling and rebalanced enemies to follow that scaling

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Update (Patch Notes)
notes.notes:
[h1]Shadowveil - Steam Next Fest Update (21.02.2025)[/h1]

[h3]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h3]
The first update to Shadowveil is here, and we'd like to share the list of changes and fixes we've implemented since the demo went live. 

Before we start the list, we'd like to thank you for playing the demo and/or following the game's development. It has been super fun seeing the response from the community and we are working hard to alleviate the issues that has been reported.

We've included the known issues at the bottom of the list, that are [b]A:[/b] either not resolved yet ([b]in bold[/b]), or [i]B[/i] simply haven't made it into today's update ([i]in cursive[/i]). 

Feel free to let us know if you encounter any of the issues in category [b]A[/b]. You can do so by submitting them in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url]: [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R[/url]

[h2]Patch notes for the Next Fest Update (21.02.2025)[/h2]
[h4]Version number: 0.1.17516[/h4]
Spoiler warning: Potential spoilers are listed with spoiler tags: [spoiler]like this[/spoiler]. 

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various optimization passes, specifically targeted at minimizing crashes related to RAM usage
(Note this is an ongoing process and we will continue with this for launch and beyond)
[/list]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added audio focus option, you can now have background audio enabled.
[*] Added save backup system to avoid total loss if save game is corrupted
[*] Added a button to dismiss non-unique units in barracks
[/list]

[h3]Updated[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated balance to match the player data we have gathered the last 2 weeks
[*] Updated subheader fonts
[*] Updated card description font to be more readable at a glance. Also increased contrast
[*] Updated [spoiler]Madōshi Corruptors'[/spoiler] “mind control.” It now stuns instead of making units switch sides
[*] Updated event rewards and art
[*] Updated challenge rewards
[*] Updated Cardviewer to reflect unlocks better
[*] Player can now drag and drop units during combat barks
[*] Combat level should now always be the same when retrying
[*] Updated traps to use titles instead of healthbars
[*] Updated titles for deployables
[*] Updated how the act title is displayed
[*] Updated enemies closer to the wall
[*] Updated blessings and other rewards should now be showcased in the reward flow
[*] Updated upgrade button on cards to be more visible
[*] Updated mission popup to showcase speaker
[*] Updated barracks character bar scroll
[*] You can no longer have negative jade
[*] Updated quest UI to support multistage missions better
[*] Updated scroll speed on some elements
[*] Updated dialogue system to be more consistent in how clicks work
[*] Updated system of how boss levels are loaded to resolve some crashes
[/list]

[h3]Critical fixes (crashes/softlocks)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when loading a save file where the world map was still generating
[*] Fixed a crash when loading a save file on a mission map
[*] Fixed a crash when loading a save file related to mission nodes
[*] Fixed a crash when the [spoiler]Oni lord[/spoiler] used abilities
[*] Fixed an issue that could crash the game when the [spoiler]Oni lord[/spoiler] attacked
[*] Fixed an issue where returning to a boss would softlock the player
[*] Fixed an issue where players got softlocked in the tutorial
[*] Fixed an issue where players got softlocked entering the tutorial boss
[*] Fixed an issue where players got softlocked from narrative barks
[*] Fixed an issue where boss levels could be streamed in incorrectly, leading to a softlock
[*] Fixed an issue with softlocks regarding the event “Conquer yourself”
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple instances of the camp screen could be accessed
[*] Fixed an issue where completing Kuni emissary did not unlock the emissary building
[*] Fixed an issue where low global illumination would spawn visual artifacts
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level-up showcase material is now showcased only in watchtower to avoid confusion
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial goblins wanted to flee due to Hida Masahiro’s supreme aura
[*] Fixed an issue where UI was hidden when it was not supposed to
[*] Fixed an issue where missions wouldn’t give rewards
[*] Fixed an issue where you could open inventory where you shouldn’t
[*] Ith’ki actually gives you the cards you purchase now
[*] Line-of-sight blockers now work properly
[*] Fixed an issue where duplicate reward screens were shown
[*] Fixed an issue where units could move in some cutscenes
[*] Fixed some issues with summoned units
[*] Fixed a lighting issue on card picks
[*] Fixed some cards wrongly stating they were passive/active when it was the other way around
[*] Fixed some cards displaying a range when they don’t have one
[*] Fixed an issue that would award duplicate cards
[*] Fixed issue with “Ancient Temple” event not giving correct unit
[*] Fixed issue with “Ancient Temple” being repeatable
[*] Fixed issue with the event “What we left behind”
[*] Units now queue up when they cannot reach any target
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple MSPD debuffs would make the unit stop completely
[*] Fixed an issue where the orders menu would showcase placeholder icons
[*] Fixed an issue where dead units' portraits wouldn't update when healed
[*] Fixed issues with tutorial popups appearing after the tutorial or outside the screen
[*] Fixed an issue where trait hovers would go outside the screen
[*] Fixed an issue where certain enemies would incorrectly target barricades first
[*] Fixed issues where blessings didn’t showcase correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where you could press enter to open certain screens
[*] Fixed an issue where reloading a save would change the combat level
[*] Fixed an issue with Sukune meeting [spoiler]Gragokku[/spoiler] would play the cutscene incorrectly
[*] Fixed an issue with chapter showcase animation
[*] Fixed various issues with challenges not unlocking or unlocking too early
[*] Fixed issue with targeting icons on healthbars
[*] Fixed issues where the rewards header would not close correctly 
[*] Fixed issues where the inventory button would disappear
[*] Fixed issues where other buttons in the UI would disappear
[*] Fixed issue where the act title did not show properly
[*] Fixed issue where chapter 3 unlocks were available early
[*] Fixed issue with trader having locked cards
[*] Fixed issue with regular items gaining eternal item tooltips
[*] Fixed issue where static shrines would be taunted by O-Ushi and stare her down
[*] Creeping taint VFX should now work
[*] Removed completed side quests from the active section of the quest board.
[*] Fixed issue with side quest outro texts being lorem ipsum when there was no end-stage text
[*] Various fixes and updates to lighting and environments
[*] Various pathfinding issues fixed
[*] Various tweaks to UI animation
[*] Various audio fixes
[*] Various fixes to animation states
[*] Various fixes to typos and text
[*] Various smaller fixes
[*] Removed Cinematic option as it is an Unreal Engine debug mode
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]

[b]A: Unresolved[/b]:
[b][list]
[*] GPU usage can be abnormally high on certain high and epic settings
[*] Playing the game with low RAM or VRAM might crash the game
[*] Trying to open inventory directly after clicking start battle can lead to a softlock (Reload save if it happens)
[/list][/b]

[i]B: Resolved, but not yet implemented:[/i]
[i][list]
[*] Loading very specific save games that are connected to some dialogues might crash the game
[/list][/i]

[b]Update (24.02.2025): [/b]
[b]Corrupted Save File issue[/b]
[i]If your save file has become corrupted, you can always try to load the backup saves. These saves are from the same campaign but are created when you come back from a run/expedition. There are up to 5 back-up save files per campaign.

You can find your saves here: 
C:\Users\"UserName"\AppData\Local\Breach\Saved\SaveGames

In that folder, you will find your save slot (for example Slot_0.sav), and see that there are multiple back-up save files, that have “_backup” in their name (for example Slot_0_Backup_0.sav). 

To replace the save file;
[olist]
[*]Delete the normal Slot_X.sav file (For example Slot_0.sav)
[*]Copy the latest backup (for example Slot_0_Backup_0.sav) and paste it in the same folder. 
[*]Right click and rename the new file (for example Slot_0_Backup_0 - Copy.sav) to Slot_0.sav.
[*]In game, you can now load the older back up save from the normal save slot in the “Load Game” menu.
[/olist][/i]


Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings

With love, 
The Palindrome Interactive team
